header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
Petitioner: Through Mr. Daud Ali Leghari, Advocate
body: 2. Through instant Petition, the Petitioner has claimed appointment against deceased quota available under Rule 11 - A of the Sindh Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion & Transfer) Rule, 1974 (APT Rules).

3. It is the case of the Petitioner that his father Bhorji was employed as Kotar in Revenue Department Government of Sindh and died while in service on 04.02.2026. Petitioner vide application dated 24.10.2026 approached the Respondents to consider his case for appointment but to no avail. Learned Counsel therefore prays for appropriate directions.

4. Learned Additional Advocate General, present in Court in other matters waives notice of the Petition and upon perusal of case file states Government of Sindh has constituted a committee to consider the cases of children of deceased employees in terms of Rule 11-A of APT Rules. He therefore, submits that the case of the Petitioner may be referred to the Departmental Scrutiny Committee. The proposal has been agreed to by Learned Counsel for the Petitioner and seeks disposal of the petition. Order accordingly.

5. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to place the case of Petitioner before the departmental scrutiny committee and decide the same within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order.
6. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
